limitations: OSM data is community mapped; not a certified field survey.
Height tags are unverified; no height estimates are inserted in this file.
Road lines are not surveyed road-surface outlines.
Water geometry has no surveyed water level, bottom elevation, or flow speed.
Multipart outline/part overlaps require deliberate rendering and collision handling.
Invalid/nonstandard relations are held rather than guessed or silently repaired.
runtime.review_changes: Only two documented landmark heights were reviewed; all other source tags preserved. No floor-based estimates applied.

height_estimates.training_note: Existing OSM height tags are not certified measurements; the sample is biased toward prominent buildings. Low-rise uses the documented generic 3m convention rather than extrapolating the high-rise sample.
